description: 60 m2 apartment on the ground floor and basement with steps and stairs, completely renovated on a quiet street, 450 meters from the Pont Cardinet metro station, which will give you an ideal location and comfort for your stays for families or groups of friends. Public parking 450 meters away at 24 Rue Brochant.Lively and commercial neighborhood: Batignolles Paris 17.The space60 m2 apartment on the ground floor and basement of a detached building consisting of:- a living room with a 140 X 190 sofa bed (18 cm mattress)- 3 bedrooms: 1 bedroom with a 160 X 190 bed, 1 small bedroom with a 90 X 200 bed and a mezzanine bedroom with 2 90 X 190 beds.- an equipped kitchen with fridge, ceramic hob, microwave, kettle, coffee maker, toaster... and cutlery for 7 people.- a bathroom with shower and washing machine- a toilet with a hand basinLinens and towels provided (1 large towel per person).High-speed Internet (Wi-Fi).Presence of 2 controlled mechanical ventilations (CMV).Air conditioning ONLY in the living room.Guest accessNo private areas, except 2 small storage closets under the stairs.I want you to feel at home and I trust you to take care of the apartment. – hotel-type listing
